facts.fact: The OQSF-CI executive secretary says consumers can bring complaints on financial services to the Observatoire through a green line, an email address and a website, and that financial mediation is part of its consumer-protection mission.
facts.system: Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers (OQSF-CI)

systems.owner: State of Côte d'Ivoire (Ministry of Finance)
